mergeMessage: drain: merge fix/worktree-vite-cache-1 — worktree-vite-cache-1 — every checkout gets its own vite dependency cache and two named entries, because vite's default entry glob followed the assets/pilots symlink into the art store and every worktree boot re-optimised the shared cache and skipped pre-bundling (three of six boots never booted; after: 2.5 to 3.4 s cold or warm, zero reloads; build byte-identical, hash unchanged) (Opus 5.5 implementer at max effort; F-TT2-2, the canyon-works boot failure)

review.title: Drain review: `worktree-vite-cache-1`, one vite cache per checkout and the entry glob that crossed into the art store (Opus 5.5 implementer at max effort)

bookkeeping.rowText: Root cause corrected (F-WVC1-1): vite's default `**/*.html` entry glob followed the `assets/pilots` symlink into the art store's `hero-3d/compare.html`, whose tsconfig extends a path that does not exist there, so every worktree boot re-optimised the SHARED `node_modules/.vite` and skipped pre-bundling (8 of 8 boots; a sampler saw eight configurations rewrite the cache 127 times in 19 minutes; three of six boots never booted). Cure in `vite.config.ts`: `cacheDir` `.vite-cache` per checkout (gitignored), `optimizeDeps.entries` index.html and the replay harness, a dev-only rewrite keeping the old deps URL for the spec and five review scripts that import it directly (F-WVC1-2, a slice). After: scan 197 ms, boots 2.5 to 3.4 s cold or warm with zero reloads, a sibling's server no longer touches this checkout's cache; build byte-identical (3,173 dist files), hash unchanged {PIN}, task-025 and m2-01 24/24. F-WVC1-3 (inferred): today's browser-door "load" reds may have been this; watch the row. No deploy (config only; the droplet rebuilds its cache once per deploy, F-WVC1-4).
bookkeeping.statusPhrase: every checkout has its own vite dependency cache and the entry glob no longer crosses into the art store, so worktree boots stop re-optimising each other
